facts.text: I have pain in my neck.
It's on the right side of my neck, in the spot where you can feel the neck pulse.
It spreads to my right ear.
Moving my head and neck sets it off.

facts.item: when the fever, tiredness and muscle aches came
facts.text: They came at the start, when the neck pain began.
I don't have a history of migraine.
I haven't had any other neurological symptoms.

findings.name: neck examination
findings.result: Localized swelling and tenderness at the right carotid bifurcation, worsened by palpation; no induration along the jugular vein.

findings.name: complete blood count
findings.result: White-cell count 9910/mm3; other values within normal limits.

findings.name: neck ultrasound with carotid Doppler
findings.result: Asymmetric hypoechoic thickening of the right distal common carotid artery extending into the proximal internal carotid artery; no intimal plaque or stenosis; Doppler: normal flow parameters. Thyroid, parathyroid and salivary glands normal; no neck mass or cervical lymphadenopathy.

findings.name: MRI of the neck
findings.result: Thin rim of hyperintense tissue surrounding the right carotid artery on STIR sequences, with diffusion restriction on DWI and marked enhancement after contrast; no significant luminal narrowing.

aliases: transient perivascular inflammation of the carotid artery
transient perivascular inflammation of the carotid artery syndrome
gold.reasoning: 1. Carotid dissection was excluded — “MRI is particularly useful in differentiating TIPIC syndrome from intramural hematoma or carotid dissection, that are the principal vascular differential diagnoses.” 2. Intramural hematoma was excluded — “MRI is particularly useful in differentiating TIPIC syndrome from intramural hematoma or carotid dissection, that are the principal vascular differential diagnoses.” 3. Carotid thrombosis was excluded — “On Doppler studies, the affected carotid artery on the right side demonstrated normal flow parameters.” 4. Neck abscess and lymphadenitis were excluded — “no neck mass or cervical lymphadenopathy was noted.” 5. Thyroiditis was excluded — “The thyroid gland, parathyroid glands and salivary glands were normal.” 6. Migraine was excluded — “Patient denied history of migraine or other neurological symptoms.” 7. Other vascular and non-vascular causes were systematically excluded by imaging — “The diagnosis of TIPIC syndrome requires imaging evidence of the exclusion of other vascular and non-vascular causes of neck pain.”

notes: Index visit: the outpatient presentation with 1 week of severe right-sided neck pain over the carotid bifurcation (s001-s007); laboratory, ultrasound and MRI results (s008-s014) are findings from the same workup.
s003: fever, tiredness and muscle aches at the start of the illness share one standalone timing fact (f011).
s009 'All other laboratory parameters were within normal limits' is a blood chemistry record (x009) and the remainder of the blood count (x006).

f013 'other neurological symptoms' is a blanket denial (s003 'denied ... other neurological symptoms'); it has no aliases naming specific symptoms, so questions about numbness, weakness or vision stay unknown.
